hook: Altman turned artificial intelligence from a research field into a consumer phenomenon and a geopolitical agenda item. ChatGPT's November 2022 launch under his leadership put generative AI in hundreds of millions of hands, and his Senate testimony six months later, a CEO asking to be regulated, set the tone for the global governance debate this library documents.
name: Sam Altman

quote.text: If this technology goes wrong, it can go quite wrong.
quote.context: Testimony to the U.S. Senate Judiciary Subcommittee, May 16, 2023

moniker: The Face of the AI Boom

primary.name: Oversight of A.I.: Rules for Artificial Intelligence, Senate Judiciary Subcommittee hearing (May 16, 2023)

secondary.name: OpenAI announces leadership transition and return, OpenAI board statements (November 2023)
The Optimist: Sam Altman, OpenAI, and the Race to Invent the Future, Keach Hagey (2025)

timeline.event: Becomes president of Y Combinator at 28
Co-founds OpenAI as a nonprofit lab
Senate testimony; fired and reinstated in November

quick_facts: CEO of OpenAI; led the company through ChatGPT's launch, the fastest-adopted consumer product in history at the time
President of Y Combinator 2014-2019 before running OpenAI full-time
Testified to the U.S. Senate in May 2023 asking for AI regulation
Fired and rehired as OpenAI CEO within five days in November 2023

achievements.title: ChatGPT launch (November 2022)
achievements.impact: Reached an estimated hundred million users in two months and made 'AI' a household verb, triggering the industry-wide race.

achievements.title: Senate testimony (May 16, 2023)
achievements.impact: Asked Congress for licensing and safety standards, the moment AI regulation became a mainstream legislative project.

achievements.title: The GPT platform and developer ecosystem
achievements.impact: APIs and the app ecosystem made frontier models the substrate for thousands of businesses.

achievements.title: Surviving the November 2023 board crisis
achievements.impact: His firing and reinstatement inside a week exposed AI governance-by-charter's fragility, a case study boards now cite.
